notes: Read SKILL.md (1244 lines) in full; it is the only file. Reference guide for building an internal developer platform: Backstage setup, catalog and templates, Crossplane XRDs/compositions, Score specs, Terraform modules, DORA metrics, and OPA/Kyverno/NetworkPolicy governance.

Following the skill can make the agent scaffold Backstage with npx @backstage/create-app@latest (SKILL.md:39), add yarn packages (:580-581), brew install score-compose/score-k8s (:720, :727), helm install Crossplane and kubectl apply providers into a cluster (:125-161), and create a Kubernetes secret from a local aws-credentials.txt (:145-147). Medium because these install tools and change cluster state with real cloud credentials; acceptable because they are standard, user-directed setup steps for the user's own platform with nothing destructive, no disabled security controls, and no remote script piped to a shell.

Config samples use ${ENV_VAR} placeholders for tokens (GITHUB_TOKEN, K8S_*_TOKEN, GRAFANA_API_TOKEN) and example hosts (*.internal, myorg); the Crossplane RDS composition sets deletionProtection: false and skipFinalSnapshot: true (:245-247), which users should tighten for production. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
